definitions.explanation: The state of a country governing itself without control by another country. Political independence.
The state of being able to support oneself financially or emotionally without depending on others.

examples.japanese: 1776{年|ねん}にアメリカが{独立|どくりつ}した。
{親|おや}から{独立|どくりつ}して{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしを{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I became independent from my parents and started living alone.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}を{辞|や}めて{独立|どくりつ}した。
examples.english: I quit my company job and started my own business.
examples.notes: 独立する = to start one's own business

notes:
USAGE: {独立|どくりつ} has two main contexts:
1. Political independence of nations
2. Personal independence (financial, emotional, professional)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{独立|どくりつ}する (to become independent)
・{独立|どくりつ}{記念日|きねんび} (Independence Day)
・{独立|どくりつ}{国|こく} (independent nation)
・{経済的|けいざいてき}に{独立|どくりつ}する (to become financially independent)
・{独立|どくりつ}{開業|かいぎょう} (starting one's own business)
・{独立|どくりつ}{心|しん} (spirit of independence)

NUANCE: When someone says they {独立|どくりつ}した from a company, it often means they started their own business in the same field.

ANTONYM:
・{依存|いそん} (dependence)
